name: reinstall-complete-trt-environment
argv:
import pathlib,subprocess,csv,importlib.metadata,json,sys
uv='/workspace/tools/uv/bin/uv';python='/workspace/envs/streamv2-trt/bin/python';requirements='/workspace/bench-20260917/streamv2-trt-requirements.txt'
subprocess.run([uv,'pip','install','--python',python,'--reinstall','--no-deps','--extra-index-url','https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128','--index-strategy','unsafe-best-match','-r',requirements],check=True)
subprocess.run([uv,'pip','install','--python',python,'--no-deps','-e','/workspace/streamdiffusionv2-20260917'],check=True)
r=subprocess.run([uv,'pip','check','--python',python],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.stdout+r.stderr)
issues=[l for l in (r.stdout+r.stderr).splitlines() if l.startswith('The package')]
assert len(issues)==3 and all('`streamdiffusionv2`' in l for l in issues) and all(any(('`'+n+'==') in l for l in issues) for n in ['torch','torchaudio','torchvision']),issues
verify="import torch,torch.fft,tensorrt,diffusers,scipy,streamdiffusionv2;print('Verified complete imports',torch.__version__,tensorrt.__version__)"
subprocess.run([python,'-c',verify],check=True)
pathlib.Path('/workspace/envs/streamv2-trt/freeze.txt').write_text(subprocess.check_output([uv,'pip','freeze','--python',python],text=True))
print(json.dumps({'status':'installed','accepted_dependency_overrides':issues}))
